text:
No hiring option can be put forward yet, because the £400k annual-salary limit was not assessable in this run.

- The comparison is **fragile** and rests on three Olumi-supplied assumptions rather than your evidence: delivery capacity, onboarding load and annual salary spend.
- The model’s outcome measures overlap substantially across all four staffing scenarios; this uncertainty is itself the finding.
- “Annual salary spend < £400k/year” remains recorded but unscored: the model currently calculates spend as a change, not a comparable annual £ level. The direction of the Q3 goal is also unstated.

A current analysis needs the salary measure anchored to an annual £ baseline and the constraint’s value frame specified before it can test the budget.
